remarks: Welcome to 9600 Boston State Road; a beautifully maintained 2007 built home situated on two picturesque acres in the desirable Town of Boston. Offering the rare combination of newer construction, expansive living space & a breathtaking setting, this three bedroom, two full bath home features a functional floor plan poised to live & entertain comfortably. Spacious and inviting living room with beautiful hardwood floors, an abundance of natural light and scenic views. Bright & functional kitchen offers plenty of cabinetry & counter space with convenient access to the home's living and dining areas. Expansive primary suite offers a wonderful retreat with a beautiful ensuite bath featuring a separate shower and soaking tub. Two additional sizable bedrooms offer comfortable accommodations and ample closet space. A light-filled three season room off the kitchen provides the perfect space to enjoy your morning coffee, entertain or simply take in the serenity of the surrounding countryside. Heading downstairs, prepare to be amazed by the massive finished walk-out basement offering an incredible amount of additional living and entertaining space! Whether you envision a spectacular family room, home theater, fitness studio or play area, the possibilities are truly endless. Direct access to the outdoors makes this lower level especially versatile and a tremendous extension of the home's living space. Outside, just over two acres of beautiful grounds offer an incredible amount of space for outdoor entertaining, gardening or simply enjoying the great outdoors. An attached two car garage offers convenient parking and additional storage. Enjoy the best of both worlds with the peace and privacy of country living while being just ten minutes from Kissing Bridge and a short drive to the charming Village of Hamburg, shopping, restaurants and entertainment. Built less than twenty years ago, this home offers the benefits of newer construction along with the space, flexibility and natural beauty of a true country retreat. A tremendous opportunity to own a beautiful home on a spectacular piece of property in the heart of the Boston Hills! Open House on Sat, October 17th from 11am-1pm
